prayerExcerpt.en-US: The Lord chose him as a priest for himself, to offer him a sacrifice of praise.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O Senhor o escolheu como sacerdote para si, a fim de oferecer um sacrifício de louvor.

meta.face: A Tuscan of about sixty-five with a warm, ruddy complexion and a BROAD, full, RECTANGULAR face — a high, broad, bald forehead with short grey hair left at the sides and a small tuft above, wide, rounded cheekbones, a short, broad, straight nose with a wide tip, round dark-brown eyes turned upward under thick, straight grey brows, a wide mouth with full lips; a short, thick grey moustache and a short, full grey beard trimmed ROUND along the broad jaw; an upturned, trusting, devout gaze.
meta.basis: The altarpiece on Wikipedia, which we checked, shows him in a black cassock with eyes raised to the Virgin and Child, balding with grey hair at the sides, a broad nose and a short grey beard. He trained as a pharmacist in Lucca before his ordination and died in Rome in 1609 at sixty-eight; the mortar and Lucca follow his life.
